title: MC Costumes
description: A simple datapack that allows disguising as animals
body:
# MC Costumes:
**a simple datapack, that adds... well costumes!**
you can disguise as a mob, by having it's spawn egg in your first inventory slot.
it achieves this by spawning a dummy mob that moves wherever the player goes, but it dosen't interfere with other mobs due to special tags

Great for Minigames and stealing Diamonds!
_(currently supporting only: pig,sheep,cow as of v0.8)_
